post.description: Mints the grant every request to the autocomplete service carries in ``X-Autocomplete-Session``. Minting writes one Order; the keystrokes it admits write nothing. An organization mints without limit unless one is set for it, ``sessions_per_window`` per ten minutes and ``sessions_per_day`` per rolling day (each ``null`` when there is none), one pool drawn from by every caller in it; past either the mint answers 429. The grant is bound to the ``Origin`` it was minted with, expires after ``expires_in`` seconds (refresh at about 80% of it; ``expires_at`` is the same instant as a UTC timestamp, for display) and admits ``request_budget`` requests per route. A sandbox application's grant is served the sandbox's own index, and its mint writes no Order and counts against neither limit. A caller whose ``autocomplete.enabled`` override is off is answered 403; a locked organization is answered 402.

routes.description: The routes the session may query and, per route, the relations a request may include or filter by. Each must be one the caller may reach (else 403) and a relation of its route (else 422); none at all is a 422, since that session could query nothing. Left out, every route the caller may query, with every relation.

v1.AutocompleteSessionGrantResponse.description: A grant from ``POST /autocomplete/sessions``, and its organization's limits.

session_token.description: Opaque, signed session grant. Send it verbatim in the ``X-Autocomplete-Session`` header of every autocomplete request; it carries its own expiry and budget.
session_token.title: Session Token

expires_in.description: Seconds until the grant expires, counted from this response. Time the refresh from this, not from ``expires_at``: it is right however far the caller's clock is off. Mint the next grant at about 80% of it so expiry never lands on the typing path.
expires_in.title: Expires In

expires_at.description: When the grant stops working, in UTC: the token's own expiry, for display and logs. Time refreshes from ``expires_in``.
expires_at.title: Expires At

request_budget.description: Requests this session may make per autocomplete route. Past it the autocomplete service answers 429 with ``session_budget_spent``; the remedy is a new session, not a retry.
request_budget.title: Request Budget

pivot_allowance.description: How many times this session may change its query to a different name before the autocomplete service refuses it (429, code 482). Growing, trimming or correcting the name being typed never counts.
pivot_allowance.title: Pivot Allowance

filter_min_stem.description: Characters the query needs before the ``person.*``, ``address.*`` and ``state`` filters narrow the suggestions; shorter, a filtered request is a 422 naming ``q``.
filter_min_stem.title: Filter Min Stem

scope.description: What this session may search: the routes, the relations per route, and the most suggestions a request may ask for. Offer a search only where its route is listed.

sessions_per_window.description: Sessions this organization may mint per ten-minute window, one number shared by every user and API key in it; the mint past it is answered 429 with a ``Retry-After``. ``null`` when there is no limit.
sessions_per_window.title: Sessions Per Window

sessions_per_day.description: Sessions this organization may mint in a rolling 24 hours, shared and refused the same way. ``null`` when there is no limit.
sessions_per_day.title: Sessions Per Day

user_sessions_per_window.description: Sessions a user signed in to the console may mint per ten-minute window, their own pool beside the organization's; past it the mint answers 429 with a ``Retry-After``. ``null`` for an API key, whose sessions are billed, or when there is no limit.
user_sessions_per_window.title: User Sessions Per Window

user_sessions_per_day.description: Sessions a user signed in to the console may mint in a rolling 24 hours, refused the same way. ``null`` for an API key, or when there is no limit.
user_sessions_per_day.title: User Sessions Per Day
